verdict.rationale: Smithery's official CLI is published as a public GitHub repository under AGPL-3.0, so part of the product's source is readable under an open license. The evidence explicitly says the registry and hosted platform code are not public, so only the CLI surface is open. Missing for 10: open-source registry and platform code, independent corroboration beyond the license file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The official Smithery CLI repository (arcadeai-labs/smithery-cli) is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0
The open license covers the CLI repository; the registry and hosted platform code are not public.
